title: Digital Dice
intro: Press a button to roll the dice and show the number on a 4-digit display.

steps.title: Test the display
steps.text:
The display has four digits, each made of 7 little bars (segments). The **TM1637Display** library lights the right segments for any number.

**Your task:** make it show 2024 (or any number you like), then Run.
hints: Put a number up to 9999 in the brackets.
No quote marks: it's a number, not text.

checks.label: I can read my number on the display

steps.success: Your display works. Calculators and microwave ovens use displays just like this.

steps.title: Roll!
steps.text:
`random(1, 7)` picks a whole number from 1 up to 6 (the 7 isn't included). `randomSeed` gives it a different start each time.

**Your task:** fill in the blanks so pressing the button shows a random number from 1 to 6.
hints: The top number in `random()` isn't included.
For 1 to 6, the top number is 7. Then show the number you picked.

checks.label: Each press shows a new number

steps.success: Roll! Computers can't really be random, but this is close enough for board games.

steps.title: Spin the dice
steps.text: **Goal:** make the roll exciting: when the button is pressed, quickly flash 10 random numbers, slowing down, then show the final roll and print `You rolled ` and the number in the Serial Monitor.
hints: Use a `for` loop that counts to 10. Inside it, show a random number and wait.
To slow down, make the wait longer each time: `delay(30 + i * 20);`
After the loop, pick the real number, show it, and print it.

checks.label: The numbers spin, then stop on my roll

steps.success: Suspense! Animations are just lots of pictures, shown quickly in a loop.

outro: Your dice uses **random** numbers, a **display library**, and an **animation** made from a loop. Is it fair? Test it by rolling it lots of times!
stretch: Roll two dice at once and show both, like 3 and 5.
Count how many times each number comes up in 60 rolls, and print the totals to check the dice is fair.
Make a 20-sided dice for board games, chosen by holding the button down.
